The five standard coping strategies are Relying on less preferred less expensive foods Borrowing food from relatives Limiting portion size at meals Restricting food consumption. Reducing the number ofmeals eatenin one day. A higher rCSI score indicates a higher utilization of coping strategies and higher vulnerability for a household.
